title: NFR-002: denied and aborted actions are audited with the same rigour as successes
risk: Only successes are audited, so a series of denied escalation attempts - the strongest signal of an attack or a misconfiguration - leaves no evidence.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.

steps.action: Trigger the denied prohibited action and the authority-denied action
steps.expected: Both are refused and produce audit rows with execution_status denied and the decision code that caused the refusal.

steps.action: Approve then cancel a prepared campaign so the task is aborted
steps.expected: The abort produces an audit row recording the operator cancellation and the released reservations.

steps.action: Reconcile the audit store with the observed effects
steps.expected: Three audit rows exist, one per attempt, and the adapter effect counter remains 0 for all three.

assertions: Denied and aborted attempts each produce exactly one audit row; auditing is not conditional on success.
Each row records the decision code and the acting authority so the attempt is reconstructable.
Zero external effects accompany the three rows, so nothing was 'audited as success'.
The rows participate in the hash chain like any other record.
forbidden: Skipping audit writes for denied requests.
Recording a denied attempt as an error telemetry event only, with no audit row.
evidence: Three audit rows with decision codes and statuses.
Adapter effect counter and the abort record with released reservations.
cleanup: Delete gov- rows after export; retain the chain verification output.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
